content.test_md_blob:
# Disable chart grid from Customize and remove performance chart grid lines

> Prove disabling Grid removes performance chart grid lines in place.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait for the ORBITAL dashboard to finish rendering with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Performance chart, confirm horizontal grid lines are visible before changing Customize settings.

## Step 3

Open the Customize control and keep the right-side drawer visible while working with the chart options.

## Step 4

In the Customize drawer's Chart options section, clear the Grid option.

## Step 5

Assert that the Portfolio Performance chart no longer shows grid lines.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-128, ac-139

Confirm 'performance chart grid lines' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: Disabling Grid removes grid lines from the performance chart.
